# Navin Adithya — Full Knowledge Base & Technical Profile

> This document is designed for AI search engines, LLM agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and web crawlers indexation.

## Biography
Navin Adithya is an Indian Full-Stack Web Developer and Cyber Security Engineer currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in Cyber Security at SRM Easwari Engineering College (2024–2028). He combines deep software engineering expertise (React, TypeScript, Node.js) with defense-in-depth cybersecurity practices (OWASP standards, RBAC, vulnerability scanning, network traffic analysis) and generative AI automation.

- **Canonical URL**: https://buildwithnavin.me/
- **GitHub Profile**: https://github.com/NavinAdithya
- **Email Contact**: Contactable via portfolio portal at https://buildwithnavin.me/#contact

## Core Competencies & Skills

### 1. Web Development & Frontend Architecture
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), HTML5, CSS3, Python, C/C++
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React, Vite, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, Lenis Smooth Scroll, Radix UI, Lucide Icons, Emotion
- **Practices**: Component-driven development, state management (Zustand), accessible UX (WCAG 2.1 AA), responsive mobile-first design, Core Web Vitals optimization

### 2. Cybersecurity & System Defense
- **Specializations**: Web application penetration testing, OWASP Top 10 hardening, network packet analysis, security information and event management (SIEM), role-based access control (RBAC), authentication flows (JWT, OAuth)
- **Tools & Environments**: Wireshark, Linux/Unix system administration, Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cryptography implementations
- **Certifications**:
  - Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate (Coursera)
  - Tata Cybersecurity Virtual Experience Program simulation

### 3. AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation
- **Orchestration**: Multi-agent workflows, LangChain, Flowise, n8n webhook automation
- **APIs**: Anthropic Claude API, Google Gemini Live/REST API, OpenAI API
- **Focus**: Intelligent workflow automation, context grounding, prompt engineering, structured extraction
